name: Aizawa Suzuka
source:
[url=/c102313]Yukito[/url]'s stepsister.
She serves as the student council president of Seioh Academy, and her versatility and cheerful personality have made her very popular within the school. 
She is extremely sweet to Yukito, and shows a capricious personality.

[From [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dark_Blue]Wikipedia[/url]]
